title: Resonant modes of a rectangular cavity with perfectly conducting walls
source: Rectangular cavity with perfectly conducting walls: f_mnl = (c₀/2)·√((m/a)² + (n/b)² + (l/d)²), a TE and a TM mode when no index is zero; D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §6.4
